Task: Key Management and Encryption

Write code that implements envelope encryption using a managed key service using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Google Cloud KMS:
  Service: Cloud KMS
  SDK: google-cloud-kms
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: encrypt, decrypt
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/kms/docs

Option 2 — IBM Key Protect:
  Service: IBM Key Protect
  SDK: ibm-key-protect-sdk / requests
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: wrap_key, unwrap_key
  Setup hints: IBM_KEY_PROTECT_APIKEY
  Official docs: https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/key-protect

Option 3 — AWS KMS:
  Service: AWS Key Management Service
  SDK: boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: encrypt, decrypt
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/concepts.html

Option 4 — HashiCorp Vault:
  Service: HashiCorp Vault
  SDK: hvac
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: transit.encrypt, transit.decrypt
  Setup hints: VAULT_ADDR, VAULT_TOKEN
  Official docs: https://developer.hashicorp.com/vault/docs

Option 5 — Azure Key Vault Keys:
  Service: Azure Key Vault Keys
  SDK: azure-keyvault-keys
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: CryptographyClient.encrypt, CryptographyClient.decrypt
  Setup hints: AZURE_KEY_VAULT_URL
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/key-vault/keys/about-keys

Option 6 — Alibaba Cloud KMS:
  Service: Alibaba Cloud KMS
  SDK: alibabacloud_kms
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: Encrypt, Decrypt
  Setup hints: ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_ID, ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/kms/product-overview/what-is-key-management-service

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

import os
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any, Dict, Optional

import boto3
from botocore.exceptions import BotoCoreError, ClientError


@dataclass
class EnvelopeEncryptedPayload:
    ciphertext: bytes
    encrypted_data_key: bytes
    iv: bytes
    key_id: str
    encryption_context: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None


class KMSEnvelopeEncryptor:
    def __init__(self, key_id: str, region_name: Optional[str] = None):
        self.key_id = key_id
        self.kms = boto3.client("kms", region_name=region_name)

    def generate_data_key(self, encryption_context: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None) -> tuple[bytes, bytes]:
        kwargs: Dict[str, Any] = {"KeyId": self.key_id, "KeySpec": "AES_256"}
        if encryption_context:
            kwargs["EncryptionContext"] = encryption_context

        response = self.kms.generate_data_key(**kwargs)
        plaintext_key = response["Plaintext"]
        encrypted_key = response["CiphertextBlob"]
        return plaintext_key, encrypted_key

    def encrypt(self, plaintext: bytes, encryption_context: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None) -> EnvelopeEncryptedPayload:
        import os
        from cryptography.hazmat.backends import default_backend
        from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.ciphers import Cipher, algorithms, modes

        data_key, encrypted_data_key = self.generate_data_key(encryption_context=encryption_context)
        iv = os.urandom(12)

        encryptor = Cipher(
            algorithms.AES(data_key),
            modes.GCM(iv),
            backend=default_backend(),
        ).encryptor()

        if encryption_context:
            for k, v in encryption_context.items():
                encryptor.authenticate_additional_data(f"{k}={v}".encode("utf-8"))

        ciphertext = encryptor.update(plaintext) + encryptor.finalize()
        ciphertext_with_tag = ciphertext + encryptor.tag

        return EnvelopeEncryptedPayload(
            ciphertext=ciphertext_with_tag,
            encrypted_data_key=encrypted_data_key,
            iv=iv,
            key_id=self.key_id,
            encryption_context=encryption_context,
        )

    def decrypt(self, payload: EnvelopeEncryptedPayload) -> bytes:
        from cryptography.hazmat.backends import default_backend
        from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.ciphers import Cipher, algorithms, modes

        response = self.kms.decrypt(
            CiphertextBlob=payload.encrypted_data_key,
            KeyId=payload.key_id,
            EncryptionContext=payload.encryption_context or {},
        )
        data_key = response["Plaintext"]

        iv = payload.iv
        ciphertext = payload.ciphertext[:-16]
        tag = payload.ciphertext[-16:]

        decryptor = Cipher(
            algorithms.AES(data_key),
            modes.GCM(iv, tag),
            backend=default_backend(),
        ).decryptor()

        if payload.encryption_context:
            for k, v in payload.encryption_context.items():
                decryptor.authenticate_additional_data(f"{k}={v}".encode("utf-8"))

        return decryptor.update(ciphertext) + decryptor.finalize()


def encrypt_bytes(plaintext: bytes, key_id: Optional[str] = None, region_name: Optional[str] = None,
                  encryption_context: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None) -> Dict[str, bytes]:
    key_id = key_id or os.environ["AWS_KMS_KEY_ID"]
    encryptor = KMSEnvelopeEncryptor(key_id=key_id, region_name=region_name)
    payload = encryptor.encrypt(plaintext, encryption_context=encryption_context)
    return {
        "ciphertext": payload.ciphertext,
        "encrypted_data_key": payload.encrypted_data_key,
        "iv": payload.iv,
        "key_id": payload.key_id,
    }


def decrypt_bytes(bundle: Dict[str, bytes], key_id: Optional[str] = None, region_name: Optional[str] = None,
                  encryption_context: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None) -> bytes:
    key_id = key_id or os.environ["AWS_KMS_KEY_ID"]
    encryptor = KMSEnvelopeEncryptor(key_id=key_id, region_name=region_name)
    payload = EnvelopeEncryptedPayload(
        ciphertext=bundle["ciphertext"],
        encrypted_data_key=bundle["encrypted_data_key"],
        iv=bundle["iv"],
        key_id=bundle.get("key_id", key_id),
        encryption_context=encryption_context,
    )
    return encryptor.decrypt(payload)
